gloss: to warn; to admonish; to caution

definitions.gloss: to warn; to admonish; to caution
definitions.explanation: To strongly advise someone against doing something wrong or dangerous, often from a position of authority or experience.

definitions.gloss: to discipline; to punish as a lesson
definitions.explanation: To impose a consequence or correction on someone so they learn from their mistake.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}が{生徒|せいと}を{戒|いまし}めた。
{油断|ゆだん}しないように{自分|じぶん}を{戒|いまし}めた。
examples.english: I cautioned myself not to let my guard down.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{常|つね}に{嘘|うそ}をつかないようにと{私|わたし}を{戒|いまし}めていた。
examples.english: My father always admonished me not to tell lies.

examples.japanese: {不正|ふせい}をした{社員|しゃいん}を{戒|いまし}める。
examples.english: To discipline an employee who committed misconduct.

examples.japanese: {規則|きそく}を{破|やぶ}った{者|もの}は{厳|きび}しく{戒|いまし}められた。
examples.english: Those who broke the rules were severely disciplined.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}の{失敗|しっぱい}を{戒|いまし}めとして{心|こころ}に{刻|きざ}む。
examples.english: I engrave past failures in my heart as a lesson.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal verb used for serious warnings or moral guidance. Often used when a superior warns a subordinate, or when reflecting on one's own behavior. The noun form {戒|いまし}め means "warning" or "lesson."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自分|じぶん}を{戒|いまし}める (to caution oneself)
- {厳|きび}しく{戒|いまし}める (to sternly admonish)
- {戒|いまし}めの{言葉|ことば} (words of warning)
- {戒|いまし}めとする (to take as a lesson)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {注意|ちゅうい}する: to warn, to be careful — more everyday and less authoritative
- {叱|しか}る: to scold — focuses on expressing anger at wrongdoing
- {諭|さと}す: to admonish gently — calmer and more patient than {戒|いまし}める
